subject: ela
intro: The main topic is what the whole text is mostly about. Key details tell us more about the topic. Kindergartners name the topic and one detail.

items.prompt:
Read.

Dogs are good pets. They can learn tricks. They keep us company.

What is the main topic?

steps: I ask: what is the whole text about?
Every sentence is about dogs as pets.
So the main topic is dogs as pets.

items.prompt:
Read.

The sun is very hot. It gives us light. It helps plants grow.

Name one key detail about the sun.

steps: Key details tell more about the sun.
One detail: it gives us light.
So one key detail is that the sun gives us light.

items.prompt:
Read.

We should wash our hands. It keeps away germs. It keeps us healthy.

What is the main topic?

steps: The text is about washing hands.
So the main topic is washing hands.
